neighbours.label: the quantity or unit noun that a step-by-step calculation instruction operates on ('Multiply seconds by 343', 'per work hour')
fire: Find the total cost in dollars. Multiply gallons by 3.50 per gallon.
To convert the time, divide minutes by 60 to get the number of hours.
Work out the area in square meters. Multiply meters by meters.
Calculate the energy used. Multiply watts by the number of hours it runs.
Find the speed of the car. Divide kilometers by hours traveled.
To get the weight in pounds, multiply kilograms by 2.2.
Estimate the wages owed. Multiply days by the daily rate of $120.
Calculate the volume in liters. Multiply milliliters by 0.001.
quiet: Find the total cost in dollars. The receipt is in the kitchen drawer.
To convert the time, ask your teacher to explain the clock again.
Work out the area in square meters. The garden is behind the house.
Calculate the energy used. The lamp has been on since this morning.
Find the speed of the car. It was painted red last summer.
To get the weight in pounds, step onto the bathroom scale.
Estimate the wages owed. The workers will be paid on Friday.
Calculate the volume in liters. The jug is sitting on the table.

notes: card: peaks on 'hour', ' letter', ' u', ' seconds' in worked-problem instructions; no single token. Probe: 'Multiply hours by ...' 0.43, other rate/substitution phrasings under 0.1. Low confidence.
